name: Tournament
description: The same task given to three agent variants in parallel, each in its own worktree; tests pick the candidates and a judge picks the winner; you approve; losers are discarded.

inputs.name: task
inputs.default: Fix src/math.js so the whole test suite passes without changing the tests: average() must include the first element and divide() must return exact results and throw on division by zero.

config.code: return ctx.nodes.contest.results.map((r, i) => ({ index: i, name: ctx.nodes.variants.value[i].name, ok: !r.error && r.test.exit_code === 0, summary: r.implement ? r.implement.text : r.error, files: r.implement ? r.implement.files_changed : [] }))

config.prompt:
Three contestants attempted the same task in separate git worktrees under .orca/worktrees/ of this repository (owner keys implement-0, implement-1, implement-2). Candidate summary:

```json
{{ orca.json(nodes.diffs.value) }}
```

For each candidate whose tests passed (ok = true), inspect its change with `git diff main..orca/tournament/{{ run.id.slice(0, 8) }}/implement-<index>` (run it from the repository root). Judge correctness first, then simplicity and clarity.

Call submit_result with: winner (index number, or -1 if none passed), ranking (array of indexes best to worst), rationale (markdown, max 150 words).

config.title: Pick the winner
config.instructions: The judge chose contestant #{{ nodes.judge.json.winner }} ({{ nodes.diffs.value[nodes.judge.json.winner].name }}). Approve to keep its worktree and discard the others.

config.title: Tournament decided
config.message: Winner: {{ nodes.diffs.value[nodes.judge.json.winner].name }}. Its branch is kept for you to review or open a PR from.

ui.notes: Map bodies with isolation = worktree get one worktree per item (implement-0, -1, -2). Git nodes outside the map address them by that key.
